pages.title: Chachagua Rainforest Hotel & Hot Springs, Costa Rica
pages.description: Boutique rainforest hotel near Arenal Volcano, Costa Rica. Bungalows, villas, natural hot springs, farm-to-table dining and guided jungle experiences.

Chachagua Rainforest Hotel & Hot Springs, Costa Rica
Skip to content
WELCOME TO THE HEART
OF THE RAINFOREST
You have found Chachagua Rainforest Hotel, a luxury eco-retreat woven into a protected rainforest reserve along the northeastern reaches of the Children’s Eternal Rainforest. Located in one of Costa Rica’s most biodiverse regions, the resort offers a rare balance of adventure and immersion. The iconic attractions of La Fortuna and Arenal Volcano are within reach, while the surrounding rainforest reveals a more authentic side of Costa Rica, where wildlife and unforgettable adventures await.
JUNGLE STAYS FOR EVERY JOURNEY
Whether you’re creating memories with family, reconnecting with friends, or escaping as a couple, Chachagua offers premium accommodations immersed in the rainforest. Thoughtfully designed and surrounded by nature, each stay provides a comfortable retreat and an authentic connection to Costa Rica’s remarkable biodiversity.

Premium Accommodations
Luxury Rainforest Accommodations for Couples, Friends & Families
Whether planning a romantic retreat, a family vacation, or a getaway with friends, Chachagua offers a collection of distinctive accommodations surrounded by pristine rainforest. Explore each unique lodging option and find the perfect place to experience Costa Rica in comfort and style.
Private Residences
Ideal for families, groups, extended stays, and digital nomads, these private residences combine the comforts of home with the natural beauty of Costa Rica. One is immersed within the hotel’s rainforest reserve, while the other is located near La Fortuna, offering easy access to the region’s attractions. With generous living spaces, full amenities, and the freedom to settle in at your own pace, they are perfectly suited for both short escapes and longer stays.
Hacienda Cercone
A Refined Retreat to Gather and Unwind
Designed for families and groups, Hacienda Cercone combines the privacy of a residence with the conveniences of a resort stay. Generous indoor and outdoor living spaces create a welcoming setting for spending time together, while its location within Chachagua offers easy access to the rainforest, hot springs, and the experiences that define the property.

Why choose Chachagua? From a collection of hot and cool spring water pools to rainforest adventures, memorable dining, and authentic cultural experiences, every moment is designed to help you relax, explore, and connect with the spirit of Costa Rica.
NATURAL SPRING POOLS
Relax, refresh, and reconnect in our collection of hot and cool spring water pools. Whether you re unwinding in a tranquil soak, enjoying the waterslide with family, or simply taking in the surrounding rainforest, every pool offers a unique way to experience nature.

Savor the flavors of Costa Rica at Colibrí Restaurant, where wraparound rainforest views, warm hospitality, and thoughtfully prepared cuisine come together to create a memorable dining experience inspired by nature and local traditions.

MORPHO RESTAURANT
Named after Costa Rica’s iconic blue butterfly, Morpho Restaurant offers a relaxed, playful atmosphere adjacent to the spring water pools. Enjoy casual dining, refreshing drinks, and laidback rainforest moments with family and friends.

The heart of our adventures, Rancho Don Lelo celebrates the rustic charm and agrarian traditions of Costa Rica. Two Bedroom Villa: Family Vacation Home | Chachagua
Skip to content
Two Bedroom Villa
Shared Space, Private Comfort
The Two Bedroom Villa spans 181 m² (1,948 ft²) of elegant indoor-outdoor living designed for families or couples traveling together. This freestanding retreat features handcrafted details, two bedrooms with private entrances and terraces, and a spacious shared deck with a hammock and heated plunge pool facing the river. With one king-size bed and two queen beds, two full bathrooms with built-in closets, and a dual outdoor rain shower, the villa blends privacy and togetherness in the heart of the rainforest.

Frequently Asked Questions
Who is the Two Bedroom Villa best suited for?
The Two Bedroom Villa is ideal for families or two couples traveling together. Each bedroom has its own private entrance and terrace, so guests enjoy independence and privacy while sharing the villa s generous common deck and plunge pool.
What is the layout like?
The villa spans 181 m² (1,948 ft²) of indoor-outdoor living. It features two bedrooms with private entrances and terraces, one king-size bed and two queen beds, two full bathrooms with built-in closets, and a spacious shared deck with a hammock and heated plunge pool facing the river.
How will I experience nature during my stay?
The villa s shared deck faces the river, and both bedrooms open onto private terraces surrounded by rainforest. Guests can also enjoy the dual outdoor rain shower, the hotel s rainforest trails, and a complimentary guided nature walk.
What services are included during the stay?
Guests enjoy daily housekeeping, complimentary a la carte breakfast at Restaurante Colibri, complimentary yoga classes on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, one guided rainforest nature tour, and personalized concierge assistance.
Does the villa have a private pool?
Yes. The villa s oversized shared outdoor terrace features a heated plunge pool facing the river, and guests also have access to the hotel s swimming pool and hot water pool.
A Villa Made for Sharing the Rainforest
The Chachagua Two Bedroom Villas are private, freestanding retreats set within lush tropical gardens and surrounded by the quiet rhythms of the rainforest. Designed for families or couples traveling together, they offer a thoughtful balance between shared spaces and personal privacy, where separate entrances and terraces allow each room to feel like its own secluded refuge.
Learn more
Each villa rests comfortably within the forest landscape, blending handcrafted architectural details with the surrounding vegetation. Native plants and shaded pathways frame the villas, creating a welcoming atmosphere that reflects the warmth and simplicity of Costa Rican design.
Inside, the villas offer approximately 181 m² (1,948 ft²) of spacious living areas, with one king-size bed and two queen beds distributed across two private bedrooms. Open layouts and large windows fill the interiors with natural light, while amenities include two full bathrooms with built-in closets, personal care products, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs in each bedroom, a capsule espresso machine with Costa Rican coffee pods, and a minibar with courtesy treats.
Each villa centers around an expansive covered terrace designed for gathering and relaxation. A hammock provides a comfortable place to unwind, while the heated plunge pool offers a refreshing retreat overlooking the surrounding rainforest and river area. Private decks for each bedroom extend the living space outdoors, creating a seamless connection between interior comfort and the natural environment.
Designed for guests seeking both togetherness and independence, the Chachagua Two Bedroom Villas provide a carefully balanced experience that blends privacy with shared enjoyment while capturing the vibrant atmosphere of the Costa Rican rainforest.

River Villa: Riverside Suite with Jacuzzi | Chachagua
Skip to content
River Villa
An Elevated Private Refuge
Perched among the treetops above the Chachagua River, these standalone villas grant adventure-loving families an immersive rainforest escape. Each villa features artisan design, 150 m² (1,614 ft²) of indoor living space with high ceilings and an open layout, panoramic views, dual terraces, and a double-head rainfall shower. A distinctive elevated tower, connected by a wooden bridge, houses a Jacuzzi handcrafted by local artisans, floating above the forest with views over the river below.

Frequently Asked Questions
Who is the River Villa best suited for?
The River Villa is designed for adventure-loving families and couples who want a standalone refuge immersed in the rainforest. With two queen beds and expansive indoor and outdoor spaces, it comfortably hosts up to four guests.
What is the layout like?
Each villa offers 150 m² (1,614 ft²) of indoor living space with high ceilings, an open layout, panoramic windows, and a bathroom with a double-head rainfall shower. Private front and rear terraces extend the living space into the treetops.
What makes the Jacuzzi tower special?
A wooden bridge connects the villa to its own elevated canopy tower, home to a Jacuzzi handcrafted by local artisans. Soaking above the forest with views over the Chachagua River is an experience unique to these villas.
What services are included during the stay?
Guests enjoy daily a la carte breakfast, one guided rainforest hike, complimentary yoga classes on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, daily housekeeping, a minibar with courtesy treats, Costa Rican specialty coffee, and personalized concierge assistance.
How close is the villa to the river?
The villas sit perched among the treetops directly above the Chachagua River. From the terraces and the elevated Jacuzzi deck you can hear the water below and watch wildlife move through the canopy around you.
A Treetop Refuge Above the River
The Chachagua River Villas are secluded, freestanding retreats perched above the Chachagua River, surrounded by dense rainforest and the quiet choreography of life in the trees. Designed for families, they stand out for their privacy, comfort, and elevated perspective, where the river appears like a hidden thread winding through trunks, leaves, and branches.
Learn more
Each villa towers within the canopy, blending into the upper layers of the rainforest like a sanctuary suspended above the ground. Surrounded by native tropical vegetation, these structures are crafted with Costa Rican design elements that evoke warmth, simplicity, and a strong sense of place.
Inside, the villas offer approximately 150 m2 (1,614 ft2) of cozy living space, with high ceilings, two Queen beds, and open layouts filled with natural light. Panoramic windows frame the forest, offering glimpses of the river below. Interior amenities include dual rainfall showers, air conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, a coffeemaker, a minibar, and complimentary minibar items.
Each villa also features an expansive terrace with two distinct outdoor areas. At the front, lounge chairs and a coffee table provide a comfortable setting for conversation or quiet mornings. Toward the back, a private wooden bridge leads to one of the most remarkable features: an elevated tower with a custom- built Jacuzzi, handcrafted by local artisans. Nestled within the canopy, this treetop retreat invites guests to unwind in soothing jet pools while taking in the ever-changing theater of the rainforest.
Designed for families seeking both comfort and seclusion, the Chachagua River Villas offer a thoughtfully crafted experience that blends privacy with immersion while capturing the vibrant spirit of the Costa Rican rainforest.
